description: This file defines the SnapshotStorage class, which manages frame snapshots, resource snapshots, and related rendering data for trace analysis in a web automation context.

classes.name: SnapshotStorage
classes.description: A class that manages storage and retrieval of frame and resource snapshots, including resource overrides and rendering.

methods.name: addResource
methods.description: Adds a resource snapshot to a specific context, rewriting its URL for custom protocols.

methods.name: addFrameSnapshot
methods.description: Adds a frame snapshot and creates a corresponding SnapshotRenderer, handling resource overrides.

methods.name: snapshotByName
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot renderer by page or frame ID and snapshot name.

methods.name: snapshotsForTest
methods.description: Returns all frame snapshot keys for testing purposes.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Sorts resources and records resource URLs with overrides to prevent stale caching.

methods.name: hasResourceOverride
methods.description: Checks if a resource URL has an override.

methods.name: _ensureResourcesForContext
methods.description: Ensures and retrieves the resource list for a given context ID.
